title: Four sides does not make a square
caption: Every square has four sides, so the squares sit inside the four-sided shapes. But a rectangle or a rhombus is also inside the four-sided set and outside the squares: knowing a shape has four sides cannot tell you it is a square.
alt: A small set of squares drawn inside a larger set of four-sided shapes, with the rectangle and the rhombus in the larger set only.
description: Draw the set of four-sided shapes.
Every square lies inside it: if square then four sides.
A rectangle and a rhombus are four-sided but not squares.
So 'four sides, therefore square' is invalid.
